author: Quaero I
title: Multi-Kernel 1D CNN for Sequence Modeling
abstract: This model enhances the previous 1D CNN by incorporating multiple parallel convolutional layers with different kernel sizes (3, 5, and 7). The feature maps from each kernel are concatenated, allowing the network to simultaneously learn and integrate local motifs of various lengths. This multi-scale approach aims to create a more robust sequence representation and improve performance across the diverse RNA modeling tasks.
